blocking_issues.title: Password-Based Authentication Completely Broken
blocking_issues.impact: Users cannot log in with password; only token-based auth works

blocking_issues.title: Query Parameters Not Sanitized for XSS
blocking_issues.impact: User input rendered in HTML without escaping; XSS payload execution possible

blocking_issues.title: SQL Injection Detection Unused
blocking_issues.impact: Detection function exists but never called; no enforcement of parameterized queries

blocking_issues.title: Rate Limit Fallback to Shared 'anonymous' Key
blocking_issues.impact: All requests without IP headers share single quota; enables shared-quota DoS

blocking_issues.title: Error Messages Expose Sensitive Data via Whitelist Bypass
blocking_issues.impact: Database schema, credentials, internal structure exposed in error responses

high_severity_issues.title: User ID Extraction Doesn't Validate x-user-id Header
high_severity_issues.impact: Header injection attack; rate limit bypass; unauthorized access

high_severity_issues.title: JWT Verification Error Handling Too Broad
high_severity_issues.impact: Token oracle attack; signature failures masked as auth failures

high_severity_issues.title: Input Sanitization Not Applied at All Entry Points
Sensitive Field Filtering Incomplete
high_severity_issues.impact: Credentials appear in logs (authorization, x-token, api_key headers)

high_severity_issues.title: Non-Crypto Fallback Uses Math.random() Without Logging
high_severity_issues.impact: Security warnings bypass log aggregation; weak token generation possible

tier_1_blocking.title: Implement validateUserCredentials() function
tier_1_blocking.description: Password login is completely broken. Implement bcrypt verification against user database.

tier_1_blocking.title: Sanitize all query parameters for XSS
tier_1_blocking.description: Apply sanitizeString() to all query params before storage; use CSP headers

tier_1_blocking.title: Enforce SQL injection detection
tier_1_blocking.description: Audit all DB queries for parameterization; call detectSqlInjection() on inputs

tier_1_blocking.title: Fix rate limiter IP fallback
tier_1_blocking.description: Require IP header; fail request if missing instead of using 'anonymous' bucket

tier_1_blocking.title: Implement error message blacklist
tier_1_blocking.description: Switch from whitelist to blacklist for safe error messages; redact sensitive fields

tier_2_high.title: Validate x-user-id header in auth middleware
tier_2_high.description: Ensure header only set by auth middleware after JWT verification

tier_2_high.title: Fix JWT error handling to distinguish error types
tier_2_high.description: Handle JsonWebTokenError, TokenExpiredError separately from other errors

tier_2_high.title: Expand sensitive field filtering
tier_2_high.description: Add patterns for authorization, x-token, api_key, access_token headers

tier_2_high.title: Fix crypto fallback logging
tier_2_high.description: Ensure logger loads successfully; fail if unavailable instead of silent fallback

unit_tests_needed: SQL injection detection on all input types
XSS sanitization on all output contexts
JWT signature verification with invalid signatures
Rate limiter behavior with missing IP header
Error message redaction for all sensitive fields
integration_tests_needed: Rate limiting with different IP header formats
security_tests_needed: XSS payload injection via query parameters
SQL injection attempt detection and blocking

deployment_decision.reason: 5 critical security issues must be fixed before production deployment

audit_conclusion: System has solid infrastructure (error handling, middleware, logging) but CRITICAL SECURITY GAPS in authentication, input validation, error handling, and rate limiting. All issues are fixable with targeted implementation. Once TIER 1 fixes are applied and tested, system is safe for production deployment with additional security monitoring enabled.
